comments.text: Hearing church bells and the adhan echoing across the exact same street corner in Mar Mikhael will never stop being breathtaking.

replies.author: @Reallifeinsights.26
replies.text: Absolutely unforgettable. Thank you for watching and sharing this!

replies.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a kind and heartfelt sentiment. You have captured the true soul of Lebanon in just a few words. Have you ever had the chance to visit or meet folks from the community in person? I would love to hear your memories or impressions.
